integrity: Analytic proof, exact-rational coefficient normalization, direct recurrence and numerical root checks; numerical diagnostics are not the uniqueness proof. No independent audit or validation.
scientific_limitations: Sharp only for the first completed update from exact positive scalar-decay data, within a specific published optimal-error two-step coefficient family. Not an all-iterate positivity, nonlinear stability, or convergence theorem. Existing all-time positivity literature is credited; unindexed one-step formula or equivalent remains a priority risk.
title: A sharp first-update positivity optimum for error-optimal two-step stiff solvers
